{{Top|leg}}
The '''Happy Starshine Collection Agency''' was a debt recovery agency that operated during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The agency sent collections agents to visit individuals who had missed payments on their [[Starship/Legends|starships]].
